An AI model that can read text and content from images.
A label such as image/png that says what kind of file it is.

sections.title: Imports and time limit
sections.what: Brings in the vision helper and the request tools, and allows 60 seconds for the request.
sections.why: Image reading can take longer than text work.

sections.name: POST
sections.title: Image to text handler
sections.what: Takes an uploaded image and returns the job description text written in it.
sections.why: Lets users skip copying text by hand.
sections.watch_out: The default instruction asks for exact text, but the AI may still summarize or miss parts.

summary: Reads text from an uploaded image of a job description using a vision AI model.
purpose: Lets users add a job description by uploading a screenshot or photo.
why: Likely reason: some job posts are only available as images.
how: Checks that image data and its type are present, sends the image to the vision helper with a default instruction to copy the text exactly, and returns the text.
inputs: Base64 image data, its MIME type, and an optional custom instruction.
outputs: Extracted text, or an error with status 400 or 500.
risks: There is no check on image size, so large uploads may be slow or costly.
debug: Errors from the vision call come back as 500. Check the AI_VISION_MODEL setting and the provider key.
